name: 199. WebRTC event filter preserves billing (OpenAI local fixture)
description: Start node tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs on 127.0.0.1:8791 and a gateway. Run FEATURE="WebRTC event filter" INCLUDE_PREVIEW=1. Each case creates and removes a unique OpenAI custom provider pointing only at the local fixture. The fixture rejects requests missing controller events or altering browser command permissions. A deliberately invalid upstream SDP produces the expected 502 only after those checks pass. Pins restricted status-only, empty and nested response selectors on /v1/live/sessions and the OpenAI integration route. Actual billing, sideband fan-out and browser event privacy are covered by tests/live/TestBilling_WebRTCFilteredEvents. No paid provider APIs are used.

item.name: [PREVIEW] [EXPECT-502] openai/gpt-live-1 WebRTC event filter status only /v1/live/sessions

exec: pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/api/providers', method: 'POST', header: headers, body: {mode:'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({provider: provider, custom_provider_config:{base_provider_type:'openai'}, network_config:{base_url:pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl'), max_retries:0, default_request_timeout_in_seconds:10}})}}, function(err, res) {
pm.test('Run-scoped fake provider created', function() { pm.expect(err).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(res && res.code, res && res.text()).to.be.below(300); });
if (err || res.code >= 300) throw new Error('cannot create fake provider');

pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/api/providers/' + provider + '/keys', method:'POST', header:headers, body:{mode:'raw', raw:JSON.stringify({name:'fake-live-key', value:'sk-fake-live-billing', models:['gpt-live-1'], weight:1})}}, function(keyErr, keyRes) {
pm.test('Fake key created', function() { pm.expect(keyErr).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(keyRes && keyRes.code, keyRes && keyRes.text()).to.be.below(300); });
if (keyErr || keyRes.code >= 300) throw new Error('cannot create fake key');

pm.sendRequest({url:base + '/api/governance/virtual-keys', method:'POST', header:headers, body:{mode:'raw', raw:JSON.stringify({name:provider, provider_configs:[{provider:provider, weight:1, allowed_models:['gpt-live-1'], key_ids:['*']}]})}}, function(vkErr, vkRes) {
pm.test('Virtual key created', function() { pm.expect(vkErr).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(vkRes && vkRes.code, vkRes && vkRes.text()).to.be.below(300); });
if (vkErr || vkRes.code >= 300) throw new Error('cannot create virtual key');
pm.test('Upstream accounting selectors and client commands passed fixture validation', function() {
// Cleanup runs here even when setup threw (newman without --bail still runs the test script):
// remove only what setup created, with the setup token the /api lock requires.
pm.sendRequest({url:base + '/api/providers/' + provider, method:'DELETE', header: cleanupHeaders}, function(err, res) {
pm.test('Run-scoped provider removed', function() { pm.expect(err).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(res && res.code, res && res.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.sendRequest({url:base + '/api/governance/virtual-keys/' + vkID, method:'DELETE', header: cleanupHeaders}, function(vkErr, vkRes) {
pm.test('Virtual key removed', function() { pm.expect(vkErr).not.to.be.ok; pm.expect(vkRes && vkRes.code, vkRes && vkRes.text()).to.equal(200); });
